text:
pagerbot: PagerDuty alert INC-2026-9 page fired for service=embeddings-prod-eu - high 5xx rate > 10% in last 3m. Link: https://pd.redwood/INC-2026-9
incident-bot: Playbook: https://playbooks.redwood/embeddings-5xx; run the 'embeddings-5xx' checklist. Priority P1. Impact: elevated 5xx and latency, some customers reporting failures. Please ack to claim.
Alice: @pagerbot acked — I'm oncall and taking this. Starting triage. :handshake: 
Alice: quick snapshot: error rate jumped at 11:38 UTC. 5xx mostly from /v1/embeddings batch endpoint. Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/emb-queue
Dave: support: support ticket #5892 — multiple EU customers reporting failed embeddings (500s). Sample customer: acme-corp; Logs show "upstream response error". I'll flag SLAs.
Carla: I'm seeing >50 502s from model-rebalancer service in logs. There was a deploy 9m ago (rebalancer v2). Could be related.
pagerbot: Escalation: due to multiple customer tickets, adding Ben to incident.
Ben: joining. On it. Alice — can you grab the failing pod logs and paste tail of model-rebalancer?
Alice: tail logs:
```
I0311 11:39:12 rebalancer.go:214] rebalancer: assign shard 12 -> pod-7
E0311 11:39:12 transport.go:87] upstream request failed: connection reset by peer
E0311 11:39:13 kvcache.go:78] kv cache OOM - attempted 512MB, available 48MB
```
Alice: also seeing many OOMKilled events on model pods in eu-central-1 nodepool.
Carla: that kv cache OOM looks bad — the rebalancer may be triggering larger cache allocations. I'm going to start a canary rollback to rebalancer v1 for EU.
Alice: running rollback now:
```
kubectl --context=prod-eu set image deployment/rebalancer rebalancer=redwood/rebalancer:v1 --namespace inference
kubectl rollout status deployment/rebalancer -n inference
```
pagerbot: Ownership update: Alice -> Carla (handed off). Carla is now primary owner.
Carla: Rollback initiated. Rolling pods back, waiting for readiness (3/3 new pods ready expected).
Carla: Rollback finished. Observed 5xx rate drop from ~12% -> ~1.4% within 2m. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/emb-queue?panelId=5
Dave: support: confirmed — customers reporting recovery. I'll update ticket #5892 and notify affected customers. :white_check_mark:
Ben: good catch. Can we add a short-term autoscaler limit to avoid kvcache spikes? I'll open a repo PR to cap memory and add more graceful backpressure.
Alice: created incident ticket INC-2026-9 in our tracker and added notes. Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood/incidents/templates/embeddings-rollback
Carla: leaving a watch for 30m. If stable, we'll mark resolved and follow up with postmortem.
pagerbot: Incident status: mitigated. Please continue to monitor. If metrics stay stable for 30m, change status to resolved.
Ben: I'll stay on the watch for 30m and then help with postmortem. Thanks team.
Alice: thanks all — handing off final watch to Ben. I'll update rotation.
